## Declarations and implementations

```plato

//==
// # Sample patterns
//
// Parameter records describing how to scatter points over a planar region.
// Generation is deterministic for a given record, including its Seed.

// The scattering strategy of a planar sample pattern.
type SamplePattern
    = RegularGrid
    | JitteredGrid
    | Stratified
    | PoissonDisk
    | Halton
    | Hammersley
    | Sobol
    | Plastic
    | BlueNoise;

// Poisson-disk scattering: random points where no two are closer than
// MinimumDistance. MaxAttempts bounds the candidates tried per point
// (typically 30). Produces even, organic distributions.
type PoissonDiskPattern2D
    implements IValue
{
    Region: Bounds2D;
    MinimumDistance: Number;
    MaxAttempts: Integer;
    Seed: Integer;
}

// Jittered-grid scattering: one point per grid cell, displaced from the cell
// center by JitterAmount in [0, 1] (0 = regular grid, 1 = anywhere in the
// cell).
type JitteredGridPattern2D
    implements IValue
{
    Region: Bounds2D;
    CellCounts: IntegerVector2;
    JitterAmount: Number;
    Seed: Integer;
}

// Stratified scattering: the region is divided into StrataCounts strata and
// SamplesPerStratum points are placed uniformly at random within each,
// bounding the variance of Monte Carlo estimates
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stratified_sampling).
type StratifiedPattern2D
    implements IValue
{
    Region: Bounds2D;
    StrataCounts: IntegerVector2;
    SamplesPerStratum: Integer;
    Seed: Integer;
}

// Halton low-discrepancy scattering: Count quasi-random points from radical
// inverses in bases BaseX and BaseY, which must be coprime (typically 2
// and 3). Deterministic and progressive: prefixes are well distributed
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Halton_sequence).
type HaltonPattern2D
    implements IValue
{
    Region: Bounds2D;
    Count: Integer;
    BaseX: Integer;
    BaseY: Integer;
}

// Hammersley low-discrepancy scattering: point i has first coordinate i/Count
// and second the radical inverse of i in Base (typically 2). Requires Count
// to be fixed in advance; even better distributed than Halton
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Low-discrepancy_sequence).
type HammersleyPattern2D
    implements IValue
{
    Region: Bounds2D;
    Count: Integer;
    Base: Integer;
}

// Sobol low-discrepancy scattering: Count points of the 2D Sobol sequence,
// skipping the first SkipCount elements (commonly to drop the origin)
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sobol_sequence).
type SobolPattern2D
    implements IValue
{
    Region: Bounds2D;
    Count: Integer;
    SkipCount: Integer;
}

// Blue-noise scattering: an even, isotropic distribution with its energy
// concentrated in high frequencies and almost none near zero. Ideal for
// stippling, dithering, and sample-position tables
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Colors_of_noise).
//
// Count is exact when the region can hold that many: generation picks the
// Poisson-disk radius that saturates at slightly more than Count points and
// then thins the result evenly back to Count. A region too small for Count
// points yields as many as fit.
type BlueNoisePattern2D
    implements IValue
{
    Region: Bounds2D;
    Count: Integer;
    Seed: Integer;
}

// Plastic (R2) low-discrepancy scattering: Count terms of the additive
// recurrence whose two increments are the reciprocal first and second powers
// of the plastic number, offset by Offset in [0, 1) (0.5 is the usual choice
// and avoids the corner). No bases, no tables, and a lower discrepancy than
// Halton in two dimensions
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Plastic_ratio).
type PlasticPattern2D
    implements IValue
{
    Region: Bounds2D;
    Count: Integer;
    Offset: Number;
}

//==
// # Sample patterns in space
//
// The spatial counterparts, for scattering through a volume rather than over
// a region: the same parameters with a third axis. The closed-form families
// generalize directly; Poisson-disk and blue noise stop at 2D, because their
// background grid has to be written to as it is filled and this vocabulary's
// arrays are immutable (see `sampling.library.plato`).

// Jittered-grid scattering through a volume: one point per grid cell,
// displaced from the cell center by JitterAmount in [0, 1].
type JitteredGridPattern3D
    implements IValue
{
    Region: Bounds3D;
    CellCounts: IntegerVector3;
    JitterAmount: Number;
    Seed: Integer;
}

// Stratified scattering through a volume: SamplesPerStratum points placed
// uniformly at random within each of StrataCounts strata
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stratified_sampling).
type StratifiedPattern3D
    implements IValue
{
    Region: Bounds3D;
    StrataCounts: IntegerVector3;
    SamplesPerStratum: Integer;
    Seed: Integer;
}
```
